content.text:
- "--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yaml"
      - "--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus"
      - "--storage.tsdb.retention.time=7d"
    volumes:
      - ./docker/observability/prometheus.yaml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yaml:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:11.2.0
    profiles: ["observability"]
    user: "0"
    ports:
      - "3001:3000"
    environment:
      GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED: "true"
      GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_ROLE: Admin
    volumes:
      - ./docker/observability/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources:ro
      - ./docker/observability/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    depends_on:
      - tempo
      - loki
      - prometheus

  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0
    command:
      - start-dev
      - --http-port=9090
    environment:
      KC_DB: dev-file
      # Public base URL of Keycloak as the browser reaches it: http://localhost:9090 locally,
      # https://9090-$WEB_HOST behind a reverse proxy. This drives the token `iss`, so it must
      # match OAUTH2_PROXY_OIDC_ISSUER_URL. STRICT=false still lets internal callers (oauth2-proxy
      # token redeem, the bootstrap container) reach Keycloak on the docker network at keycloak:9090.
      KC_HOSTNAME: ${KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:9090}
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: false
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: true
      # Honour X-Forwarded-* from the TLS-terminating reverse proxy (no-op locally).
      KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      KC_FEATURES: token-exchange
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: true
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "bash -ec 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000; printf \"GET /health/ready HTTP/1.0\\r\\n\\r\\n\" >&3; head -n 1 <&3 | grep -q \"200\"'",
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30

  keycloak-bootstrap:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0
    depends_on:
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET: ${LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET}
      LOCAL_USER_ID: ${LOCAL_USER_ID}
      LOCAL_USER_EMAIL: ${LOCAL_USER_EMAIL}
      LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD: ${LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD}
      LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME: ${LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME}
      LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME: ${LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME}
      # Used to register the OIDC client's redirectUris / webOrigins (see bootstrap.sh).
      FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL: ${FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
      - ./docker/keycloak/bootstrap.sh:/bootstrap.sh:ro
    entrypoint: ["/bin/bash", "/bootstrap.sh"]

  oauth2-proxy:
    image: quay.io/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy:v7.8.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:4180"
    depends_on:
      keycloak-bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      OAUTH2_PROXY_HTTP_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0:4180
      # Default upstream is the frontend dev server (runs on the host via process-compose).
      # The extra /dms-local/ route serves MinIO same-origin so browser uploads/downloads avoid
      # cross-origin CORS preflight, which an authenticating reverse proxy blocks. MinIO uses
      # path-style addressing and SigV4 signs the Host header. An authenticating reverse proxy may
      # rewrite the inbound Host (the real host is moved to X-Forwarded-Host) before oauth2-proxy
      # sees it; PASS_HOST_HEADER would then forward that wrong Host to MinIO and presigned URLs
      # fail with 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch. So /dms-local/* is routed through the minio-proxy
      # sidecar, which restores Host from X-Forwarded-Host before MinIO validates the signature.
      # Longest-prefix wins, so /dms-local/* goes to minio-proxy and everything else to the
      # frontend. Add one route per additional browser-facing bucket.
      OAUTH2_PROXY_UPSTREAMS: http://host.docker.internal:3002,http://minio-proxy:9000/dms-local/
      # Trust X-Forwarded-* from the reverse proxy (no-op on plain localhost).
      OAUTH2_PROXY_REVERSE_PROXY: "true"
      OAUTH2_PROXY_PROVIDER: keycloak-oidc
      OAUTH2_PROXY_CLIENT_ID: local-client
      OAUTH2_PROXY_CLIENT_SECRET: ${LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET}
      OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECRET: ${OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECRET}
      # true under HTTPS (behind a reverse proxy), false for plain-http localhost.
      OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECURE: ${OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
      OAUTH2_PROXY_EMAIL_DOMAINS: "*"
      OAUTH2_PROXY_REDIRECT_URL: ${FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:3000}/oauth2/callback
      OAUTH2_PROXY_SKIP_PROVIDER_BUTTON: "true"
      OAUTH2_PROXY_CODE_CHALLENGE_METHOD: S256
      # Browser-facing (front-channel) Keycloak URLs use the public host; the back-channel
      # (redeem/jwks/profile) stays on the docker network and never traverses the reverse
      # proxy. OIDC discovery cannot express that split, so the endpoints are set explicitly.
      OAUTH2_PROXY_SKIP_OIDC_DISCOVERY: "true"
      OAUTH2_PROXY_OIDC_ISSUER_URL: ${KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:9090}/realms/local
      OAUTH2_PROXY_LOGIN_URL: ${KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:9090}/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/auth
      OAUTH2_PROXY_REDEEM_URL: http://keycloak:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/token
      OAUTH2_PROXY_OIDC_JWKS_URL: http://keycloak:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/certs
      OAUTH2_PROXY_PROFILE_URL: http://keycloak:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/userinfo
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"

  spicedb:
    image: authzed/spicedb:v1.49.0
    container_name: spicedb
    command: >
      serve
      --datastore-engine=memory
      --grpc-preshared-key=${AUTH_SPICE_DB_TOKEN}
    environment:
      ZED_TOKEN: ${AUTH_SPICE_DB_TOKEN}
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "grpc_health_probe", "-addr=:50051" ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    ports:
      - "50051:50051"

volumes:
  postgresql_data:
    driver: local
  minio_data:
    driver: local
  qdrant_data:
    driver: local
  tempo_data:
  loki_data:
  prometheus_data:
  grafana_data:

configs:
  # Loads the public gesetze-normen seed (deconstructed norms) on first
  # database initialization. Runs after init.sql created the databases.
  postgresql_seed_gesetze_normen:
    content: |
      echo "Seeding the gesetze-normen database from /seed/gesetze-normen-seed.sql.gz"
      # sed drops pg_dump 17 statements that PostgreSQL 16 does not know:
      # the \restrict guard and the transaction_timeout setting.
      gunzip -c /seed/gesetze-normen-seed.sql.gz \
        | sed -e '/^\\restrict /d' -e '/^\\unrestrict /d' -e '/^SET transaction_timeout/d' \
        | psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname gesetze-normen
      echo "Finished seeding the gesetze-normen database"

  postgresql_init_sql:
    content: |
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE temporal'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'temporal')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE spicedb'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'spicedb')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE project_logic'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'project_logic')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE dms'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'dms')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE formal_completeness_check'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'formal_completeness_check')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE plausibility_notes'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'plausibility_notes')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE examination_service_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'examination_service_db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE administrative_file_draft'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'administrative_file_draft')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE diplan'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'diplan')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE comment_service_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'comment_service_db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE feedback_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'feedback_db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE objections_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'objections_db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE identity_management_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'identity_management_db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE supplementary_requests'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'supplementary_requests')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE fpp'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'fpp')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "gesetze-normen"'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'gesetze-normen')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "begruendungen-db"'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'begruendungen-db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "jura-db"'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'jura-db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "fallvergleichsservice-db"'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'fallvergleichsservice-db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "rechtsaenderungsmonitoring-db"'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'rechtsaenderungsmonitoring-db')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE rechtsbegriffe'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'rechtsbegriffe')\gexec
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE temporal_job_service_db'
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'temporal_job_service_db')\gexec

      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

      \connect project_logic
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect dms
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect formal_completeness_check
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect plausibility_notes
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect examination_service_db
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect administrative_file_draft
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect diplan
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect "gesetze-normen"
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect "begruendungen-db"
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect "jura-db"
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect "fallvergleichsservice-db"
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect "rechtsaenderungsmonitoring-db"
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect rechtsbegriffe
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
      \connect temporal_job_service_db
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
